Preventive measures for HMPV : -

* Maintain cleanliness
* Wash hands with soap & water for 20 seconds 
* Wearing a mask
* Avoid crowded places 
* Sanitize frequently touched surfaces
* Cover your mouth while coughing and sneezing

#HMP
